title: Myths vs Facts: ‘My BP Is Fine Because It’s Normal at the Doctor’s Office’—Why That Misses 24-Hour Non-Dipping Patterns in Shift Workers
description: Debunks clinic-only measurement reliance using ambulatory data from rotating-night-shift nurses and truck drivers, highlighting nocturnal surges, sleep fragmentation, and circadian misalignment risks.
primaryKeyword: normal clinic blood pressure shift workers
